head_height.value: 32-36 mm optimal (acceptable range 27-40 mm); face must take up 70-80% of photo

clothing_restriction.value: Darker shades mandatory; light-colored clothes blend with white background; uniform components not acceptable

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, looking directly at camera

glasses_policy.value: Dark tinted glasses and sunglasses prohibited; frames must not cover any part of eyes; no flash reflections on lenses

ears_visibility.value: Both left and right sides of face must be visible

face_visibility.value: Face visible from bottom of chin to crown (top of head, not top of hair); both sides of face must be visible

headwear_policy.value: Hats prohibited; religious head coverings (hijab) permitted if face visible from chin to crown and eyebrows visible

accessories.value: Facial ornaments obscuring features prohibited; excessive makeup not permitted; no nose rings, hoops, excessive jewelry; no fake eyelashes
